title: Grateful Dead Live at Soldier's And Sailors Memorial Hall on 1979-02-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkII) -> Apogee MiniMe (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM 250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Great audience‑sourced recording with crisp sound and standout Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain and Estimated Prophet → Eyes of the World sequences.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about this 1979 show, highlighting a superb performance that shines on the seamless Scarlet > Fire and the inspiring Estimated > Eyes segues. The audience recording, captured with a Sony ECM‑250 mic and mastered by Charlie Miller, is praised for its clear, satisfying sound that rivals many SBD tapes.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are highly positive (3×5‑star, 1×4‑star) and specifically commend both the musical performance and the audio quality, indicating an excellent show with a good‑to‑excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp sound thanks to Charlie Miller's mastering; audience mic capture is described as comparable to SBD quality with no noted dropouts or muddiness.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
Estimated Prophet > Eyes of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly, with a strong finish ('bitter end') and memorable transitions that keep listeners engaged throughout.
